title: English Royal Family (Tudors)

source.author: Compiled by Chris Phillips
source.canon: Sources cited: The Complete Peerage; Scots Peerage; Mary Boleyn's Carey children  - offspring of King Henry VIII?; The Earlier Tudors 1485-1558; Dictionary of National Biography
source.covers: 268 people and 175 families, imported from a public GEDCOM sample.

notes: Imported from English+Tudor+Royal+Family.ged (Windows-1252; PAF 5.1.12.0; file dated 30 Aug 2003) by scripts/gedcom-to-saga.mts.
Display names are the person's name only; a monarch is shown by their regnal name (e.g. King Henry VIII). Titles, title dates and life dates are not imported.
Houses are surnames; only the 12 largest keep their own colour, the rest are grouped as "Other families".
